permanant
permanent
permenant
MLV3-S13.spelling_pattern: two unstressed vowels: the middle a and the -ent ending

MLV3-C02.correct_answer: Every summer we hold a parade on Independence Day, and every fall a fair.

student_error.Every Summer we hold a parade on Indepen: Capitalizes 'summer' because it names a time of year, like the holiday in the same sentence.
student_error.Every summer we hold a parade on Indepen: Capitalizes 'fall' because it names a time of year, the way months and holidays are capitalized.
student_error.Every Summer we hold a parade on Indepen: Believes seasons are capitalized like months and holidays.

MLV3-C02.explanation: Independence Day is the name of a holiday and is capitalized, but seasons such as summer and fall are common nouns and stay lowercase. 'fair' is not the name of an event here.
MLV3-C02.cap_rule: seasons stay lowercase while a holiday is capitalized
